message: 《🎆 AKB48睽違七年再次來台演出 📷》 AKB48今天即將前往大巨蛋演出，為樂天桃猿「SINGDOME 音樂電台」主題日擔任開球及賽後表演嘉賓！ 會前他們也接受了台灣媒體訪談，分享關於來台灣的感想以及期待，其中山內瑞葵更是繼2019年在台北小巨蛋演出後相隔七年再次來台演出，有沒有朋友已經在現場等待了呢！ ATC Taiwan特別專訪也敬請期待！ #星月花齊聚一堂也令人期待 攝影：Whosdandan

Dahlias. If you follow me you'll know I love quirky dahlias that are independent and don't obey the rules. Here is a very unusual Arabian Night with some lovely white petals in the mix! I absolutely love it 😍

The best fall experience in Kyoto Japan 🇯🇵🍁 We booked this scenic boat ride for the autumn views… but didn’t expect a tiny floating shop to casually drift up beside us selling hot oden, mochi and traditional Japanese snacks. 🥹 This was the moment that made the whole experience feel so special. Cruising through the fall colours, eating warm oden on the water, and watching another little boat float over to take your order — this is exactly the kind of Japan experience I travel for. Would you add this to your Japan fall itinerary? #arashiyama #explorejapan #visitjapan
